result.summary: Found 1 minor visual issue related to the notification icon's unread indicator positioning.

issues.description: The red dot unread indicator on the bell notification icon is misaligned and sits outside the bounds of the circular notification button, appearing detached instead of overlapping the top-right corner of the bell icon as expected for notification badges.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the red dot to sit overlapping the top-right edge of the bell icon within the notification button's visual area, aligning it properly as a notification badge.
